changelog:

- AI Overviews & Slop Filter: Eliminates Google Search AI Overviews, Meta AI prompts on Instagram, Grok drawer and trend cards on X, and Reddit AI summaries.
- Extended Tracking Blocklist: Added social ad telemetry endpoints and mass-generated AI content mill domains.
- Menu Defense Indicators: Real-time Social Shield and AI Filter active status badges in browser menu.
